rideshare.note: The pick-up and drop-off points for all rideshare transit are Crawford Circle, located just outside the South Gates off Avenue of the Republic, and the North Gate located on Georges Hill Drive.

concessions.note: The food and drink options at the Skyline Stage at the Mann include a variety of offerings, though specific details are not available from the provided content. Visitors can expect a selection of food stands and vendors catering to different tastes.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Skyline Stage at the Mann, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Skyline Stage at the Mann's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Skyline Stage at the Mann. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Skyline Stage at the Mann. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
